headword: {衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}ける
gloss: to be shocked; to receive a shock; to be struck by impact

definitions.gloss: to be emotionally shocked; to be deeply affected
definitions.explanation: To experience a strong emotional reaction, typically surprise mixed with distress, upon learning unexpected news or witnessing something startling.

definitions.gloss: to receive a physical impact; to sustain a shock
definitions.explanation: To be subjected to a physical force or blow.

notes:
A common expression combining ⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧ (shock; impact) and ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive). The emotional sense (sense 1) is far more common in everyday conversation than the physical sense (sense 2). When used emotionally, it describes a strong, sudden reaction — stronger than ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ (to be surprised) but not necessarily negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}ける: to receive a big shock
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}ける: to be shocked by ~
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}ける: to receive a strong impact
- ⟦カルチャー→カルチャー：10844_karuchaa⟧⟦ショック→ショック：03847_shokku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to experience culture shock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ショック→ショック：03847_shokku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be shocked — casual equivalent using the loanword
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧: to be surprised — milder, does not necessarily imply emotional distress
- ⟦{愕然|がくぜん}→愕然：08682_gakuzen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be stunned — literary, emphasizes being rendered speechless
